# Time budgets for go test, read by internal/testtime.
#   leaf SECONDS                  a test that has no subtests
#   package PATH|default SECONDS  wall time of one package
#   test PATH NAME SECONDS        tests of PATH whose name starts with NAME
# Each number is about 2 times the slowest CI run seen, with a floor, so runner noise does not fail a
# build and a test that grows several times over does. A change that makes a test slower raises its
# number in the same diff and states why.
leaf 45
package default 45
package e2e 150
package internal/workspace 90
test internal/workspace TestChangesRefusals 75
